info.title: Health investment API
info.description: Money is a decimal integer STRING in minor units; weight is kg as a string with up to three decimals; business dates are YYYY-MM-DD in the plan's frozen time zone. Ownership is derived from the verified session only, and an unowned id returns 404, never 403.

post.description: Registered only when AUTH_MODE=dev. Returns 404 in every other mode, and the API refuses to start with AUTH_MODE=dev under NODE_ENV=production.

get.summary: Read the signed-in profile and the active plan id

patch.description: Changing the profile time zone never moves historical entries: every plan keeps the zone it froze at creation.

parameters.description: The version from your last read, e.g. "3". A mismatch returns 412 stale_version.

delete.description: Sets deactivated_at and deletion_requested_at and enqueues an account_erasure outbox job in one transaction. Access is refused from the next request onward.

post.summary: Record a consent grant or revocation
post.description: Append-only: a consent record is never rewritten, so the history of what was agreed and when stays intact.

get.summary: Budget, progress, cost efficiency and scheduled forecast
get.description: Returns the DashboardMetrics shape from @hi/contracts. as_of defaults to plan-local today and is capped at today and the plan last day. Unavailable metrics are null with a stable reason.

get.summary: Weekly weight trend, including explicit null gaps
get.description: Returns WeeklyTrendPoint[] from @hi/contracts as a JSON array. Weeks inside the plan with no readings are emitted with trendKg: null and missing: true; weeks entirely after the cutoff are not emitted.
